## Notes

- Repositories call SaveChanges themselves, so one service operation can commit several times. See `kit contract commit-side-effect-order`.
- Some dates are stored as strings; they sort and compare as text. See `kit contract time-kind`.
- A connection string is written in code; move it to configuration or user secrets before it reaches a shared repository with a password.
